question: Which of the following banks was not nationalized during the nationalization of banks in 1969?
solution:
The correct answer is __**SBI**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The State Bank of India (SBI) **was not nationalized in 1969 because it was already nationalized in 1955.**
 
• The **SBI was previously known as the Imperial Bank of India, which was formed in 1921 by merging three banks.**
 
• The **SBI is the largest public sector bank in India**
 
• SBI is a public sector bank, meaning it is owned and operated by the government of India.
 
• It **operates in more than 30 countries, i**ncluding regions like the Middle East, Africa, Europe, and the Americas.
 
• SBI has embraced digital banking with services like **YONO (You Only Need One)**, a mobile banking app that offers a variety of financial services, including shopping, bill payments, and fund transfers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The nationalization of banks in 1969 took place in two phases: **
 
• **First Phase 1969**:
 
 
• In 1969, the Government of India nationalized **14 major private sector banks**.
 
• This **was done to promote economic development by directing more credit toward priority sectors like agriculture, small-scale industries, and the rural economy**.
 
• The nationalization aimed at ensuring greater public control over the financial system and increasing access to banking services across the country.
 
 
 
• **Second Phase (1980):**
 
 
• **​**In 1980, another 6 private sector banks were nationalized to further expand the reach of public banking services and promote economic development.
 
• Those are 
 
 
• Andhra Bank
 
• Corporation Bank
 
• New Bank of India
 
• Oriental Bank of Commerce
 
• Punjab & Sind Bank
 
• Vijaya Bank
